content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: I. During the term of the non-exclusive license agreement, Licensor shall receive from Licensee one third (33%) of the gross amounts earned by the Licensee from third parties applicable to the following areas of the Licensed Technology usage (if any), ("Supplemental Payments"):
input.rationale: Searches for most-favoured-nation / "no less favorable" / best-price-matching language returned nothing, and a full read of the fee and payment provisions (tiered per-ticket price table at p0059–p0063, Time of Payment, Supplemental Payments at p0074–p0084), the definitions in Article I, and the General Provisions (including the entire-agreement clause at p0155) confirms there is no MFN mechanic in either direction. The closest provision is the Supplemental Payments revenue share at p0078, under which Licensor takes 33% of certain third-party amounts we earn; that is a fixed profit-share on defined revenue streams, not an obligation to extend SFG the best terms we grant to any third party or to match third-party offers, so it does not engage this rule. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), and nothing needs to be preserved for us since no Vendor-granted MFN exists either. No redline proposed.
